niche: separating a fieldwork artifact from a real labour market move in a national household labour survey's quarterly unemployment rate, where a first-interview visit limit changed which households a five-quarter rotating panel recruits
stakeholder_role: head of labour market statistics at a national statistics office, who must say in the July to September release whether the quarter's rise in the unemployment rate is real and what the first-interview visit limit will do to the published rate through September 2027

spine.entity: one person aged 15 or over in a responding household in one quarter's sample, with wave, household serial, ILO status items, region, age, sex and final person weight
spine.source: synthetic (fictional national household labour survey microdata)

world.org_type: national statistics office running a quarterly household labour survey with a five-wave rotating panel (first interview face to face, waves 2 to 5 by telephone)

driver: A change at the point units are recruited filters out a hard-to-reach share whose outcomes differ from the rest, and because every recruited unit stays for a fixed run of later periods carrying part of that difference, the distortion in the aggregate builds as filtered intakes replace unfiltered ones and lingers for a full run after the change is reversed; only removing the hard-to-reach recruits from each intake the change touches, at that intake's position in the run, measures each period's distortion, while the first-period gap repeated only while the change lasts, or the same gap applied at every position, files a wrong path.
driver_concrete: Since July 2026 first interviews stop after three visits, so the households reached only at a fourth to sixth visit, whose members are more often in work and out by day, drop out of each new wave-1 intake; those households would have stayed for five quarters, interviewed by telephone in waves 2 to 5, and their lower unemployment partly persists as statuses churn and they attrit, so the limit's distortion of the published unemployment rate builds through Q4 2026 and, with six visits restored in January 2027, still holds the rate above the labour market in every quarter to September 2027 as the two capped intakes age out.
stump: A competent solver finds the visit limit in the field instruction, measures how much removing fourth-to-sixth-visit households moves the wave-1 rate, treats the limit as a first-interview effect that repeats each quarter it runs and ends the quarter six visits return, and files the July to September rise as mostly the limit with the published rate back on the labour market from January 2027; the step that lands it there is missing that the households recruited under the limit are the same households interviewed in waves 2 to 5, so the selection rides on through every quarter to September 2027.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who derives ILO status correctly, re-rakes the weights and reads the field instruction measures the limit on the latest wave-1 intake only, carries that gap while the limit runs and drops it to zero once six visits return, so the published rate is called clean from January 2027 when it still runs above the labour market through September 2027.
domain_test: The deciding analysis is the survey methodologist's fieldwork-effort selection read through a rotating panel's recruitment cohorts (who a contact protocol recruits, how long they stay, how their selected outcomes regress) and the calibrated estimator's response; with another field's nouns there is no visit protocol, no recruited cohort riding five waves and no re-raked rate, so the task stops making sense.
layer1: person-quarter microdata with ILO status from questionnaire items, final weights raked to population controls
a wave-1 contact log keyed by address serial, one row per visit, with tablet re-syncs
population controls in two vintages after a population estimate rebase
a superseded field instruction beside the current one
published release tables revised after the rebase
a regional boundary change recoding two areas

differentiation.task132: Both turn on who is in a population and file a forward figure, but task132 restarts a replaced item at the bottom of a wear curve inside a spares count, while task125 tracks a recruitment protocol's selection riding a rotating panel's intakes through their later waves and the estimator's rate, with no replacement, wear or spares.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-10: in-house solver rounds 1 and 2 landed (80.2, 85.1), judge SEND_BACK on hygiene (the payments ledger read as generated); FAILED_TO_STUMP, re-rooted 2026-10-12 under the no-retirement rule
lineage.driver: The forward count of items a fixed band rule selects includes units outside the band today: each unit's periodic amount is one sum over every component it holds, a filed date in the forward window ends one class of component, and re-summing what survives moves the unit's amount into the selected band; some units are paid in two equal parts to two linked payees, and how a unit is paid depends on how many components it keeps, because the record's own changed units show that a unit left with one component is paid its whole amount by the first payee and nothing by the second; a forecast that treats every linked unit as always paid in halves carries the one-component units' halves below the band's lower floor and out of the count, and only applying the payment rule recovered from the changed units puts each such unit's whole amount into the band once a period, after a fixed-term cohort run-off on a term recovered from an earlier completed cohort, the whole-amount decomposition and the linked-pair re-sum have all been made and read as final.

Interviewer falsification was considered for this draw and dropped before registration (fabricated interviews are a planted defect under the three rules). Strategy: composition_mix and population_selection both fit (the sample's mix on a recruitment property no person column names shifts as filtered intakes rotate in); composition_mix is filed because the distortion is read as the panel's mix moving under a correct pooled rate, rebuilt from the contact log joined to the panel.
